Value vs price. Profit vs price. Growth in profit and in the share price over about three years; the grade says whether the P/E fell (A ≤ −25%, B ≤ 0) or rose (C ≤ +33%, D above). How the value is calculated

  1. Earnings per share: the latest reported earnings, annualised.
  2. Value = 5 years of earnings growing at g, then sold at 15x, discounted at 10% (no-growth multiple 13.1x), plus net cash.
  3. Growth needed = the yearly growth that makes the value equal the price.
  4. Rule: green if it needs ≤ 5% a year, blue 5–25%, red ≥ 25%. Cyclicals and cash conversion below 70% are capped at blue.
Worked example: EPS $8.98 × 13.1 (no-growth multiple at 10%) + $3.88 net cash = $121.55. To be worth $354.88, earnings must grow +27.3% a year for 5 years.

How the value is calculated

  1. Owner earnings = adjusted net income + D&A − sustaining capex, × periods a year.
  2. No re-pricing to spot: earnings stay at the company's own realised prices.
  3. Value = owner earnings × 10 (cautious) and × 13 (fair), plus net cash per share.
  4. Rule: BUY needs a 20% margin of safety at 12x and AISC ≤ 60% of spot. 25x and above is the sell zone.
Worked example: (9,940 − 4,444) × 4 ÷ 1,946.0m shares = $11.30 a share. × 10 − $10.63 net debt = $102.34 (cautious); × 13 = $136.24 (fair). Price $216.35.

How the value is calculated

  1. Earnings per share: the latest reported earnings, annualised.
  2. Value = 5 years of earnings growing at g, then sold at 15x, discounted at 10% (no-growth multiple 13.1x), plus net cash.

How the value is calculated

  1. Owner earnings = adjusted net income + D&A − sustaining capex, × periods a year.
  2. No re-pricing to spot: earnings stay at the company's own realised prices.
  3. Value = owner earnings × 12 (cautious) and × 15 (fair), plus net cash per share.
  4. Rule: BUY needs a 20% margin of safety at 12x and AISC ≤ 60% of spot. 25x and above is the sell zone.
Worked example: (958 + 698 − 682) × 4 ÷ 1,497.0m shares = $2.60 a share. × 12 − $6.18 net debt = $25.05 (cautious); × 15 = $32.86 (fair). Price $50.91.
